sources.title: Introducing Arcee Agent: A Specialized 7B Language Model ... - Arcee Blog
sources.snippet: We are excited to announce the release of Arcee Agent, a cutting-edge 7B parameter language model designed specifically for function calling and tool use. Initialized from Qwen2-7B, Arcee Agent offers performance comparable to much larger models while maintaining efficiency and speed.
